info.title: Future AGI Management API
info.description: The endpoints defined below allow users to programmatically carry out various actions on the Future AGI platform.

get.description: List immutable versions for one visible dataset.

post.description: Create an immutable dataset snapshot from an explicit items list of at most 10,000 entries and a JSON request body at most 10 MiB (10,485,760 bytes). Oversized bodies return 400 before JSON parsing. An empty list creates an empty version; mutable dataset rows are never read implicitly. Requires workspace write access. Parent versions must belong to the same visible dataset. Returns version metadata; read items through the detail endpoint. This POST is not idempotent: every accepted request, including a retry, creates a fresh version.

get.description: Read one version and a bounded page of its provenance-bearing items.

post.description: Create or replay a pinned external-task run. Both first creation and identical UUID replay return 200; no task is executed. Tenant, workspace and actor come from authentication. Creation body is limited to 10485760 bytes; JSON config/metadata fields to 262144 bytes. Configuration and code revision metadata are caller-supplied provenance, not executable-code attestation.

Atomically ingest 1–100 caller-executed results for a pinned external run. Identical receipt/payload replay is a no-op, including after completion. Conflicts roll back the whole batch. Finalization is derived only when every planned identity is terminal. Body is limited to 2097152 bytes, each item to 1048576 bytes and each output/error/usage JSON field to 262144 bytes. This endpoint does not execute tasks or attest trace/evaluator provenance.

Compare compatible persisted runs. Requires the same dataset version, exact example/trial plan and selected evaluator binding. At most 10,000 planned and recorded items per run; excess evidence is rejected, never truncated. Tenant and workspace scope come from authentication. Optional include_trial_stability returns per-example counts, observed assessed-score population standard deviations and paired candidate-minus-baseline deltas; deviations are null below two assessed trials and imply no statistical significance. An optional release_gate derives a case-level verdict requiring valid evidence for the complete plan on both sides; a failed gate still returns 200. Optional diff_case returns one bounded canonical output comparison for an exact pinned case/trial; it does not read traces or make writes. This endpoint does not execute tasks or attest caller-supplied evidence.

input.title: Input
input.description: Any non-null JSON value; nested nulls are allowed.
